statement: ∀ (c a b : ℝ) (f g h df dg dh : KdVPlan.Path), KdVPlan.SrcTriBound c a b f g h df dg dh → KdVPlan.TriBound (c*KdVPlan.csrc^2) a b f g h df dg dh
proof:
intro c a b f g h df dg dh hs
have hp : 0 < KdVPlan.csrc := Real.sqrt_pos.2 (mul_pos (by norm_num) Real.pi_pos)
have hu : (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin 3)) = {0,1,2} := by decide
have h0 := hs.2 0
have h1 := hs.2 1
have h2 := hs.2 2
simp only [hu] at h0 h1 h2
norm_num [KdVPlan.srcN, KdVPlan.srcX] at h0 h1 h2
unfold KdVPlan.TriBound KdVPlan.HB
refine ⟨⟨hs.1, ?_⟩, ⟨hs.1, ?_⟩, ⟨hs.1, ?_⟩⟩
all_goals
  apply (mul_le_mul_left hp).mp
  first
  | convert h0 using 1 <;> ring
  | convert h1 using 1 <;> ring
  | convert h2 using 1 <;> ring
